name: collaborative-canvas
description: Multi-tenant, local-first, real-time collaborative canvas built on CRDTs.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @canvas/server" "npm run dev -w @canvas/web"
scripts.dev:cluster: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n node-a,node-b,web -c blue,cyan,magenta "PORT=4000 NODE_ID=node-a npm run dev -w @canvas/server" "PORT=4001 NODE_ID=node-b npm run dev -w @canvas/server" "VITE_COLLAB_SERVERS=http://localhost:4000,http://localhost:4001 npm run dev -w @canvas/web"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis jaeger
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
